items.difficulty_reason: Compactness of the Hilbert-style derivability relation (statement 905-913, proof 915-927): item (1) is fully written with the finite-sequence argument; item (2) is a single displayed reduction to (1) via contraposition - the reduction line itself is present, so it reads as a completed two-part proof rather than an omission. H2: first part constructive, second part a named contrapositive instance.
